//: Azure Container Apps scale rule for Orleans.Lattice.Scaling (issue #1188).
//scraper: A 'custom' scale rule of type 'metrics-api' polls the app's /lattice/scale endpoint and reads the scalar at valueLocation 'scaleValue'. KEDA (which backs ACA custom scale rules) divides the scraped value by targetValue to derive the desired replica count.
//placement: This fragment goes under properties.template.scale.rules[] of a Microsoft.App/containerApps resource (api-version 2024-03-01 or later).

metadata.//targetValue: One replica-unit of scaleValue maps to one desired replica. scaleValue is already expressed in replica-units, so targetValue '1' makes the autoscaler track it directly.
metadata.//url: Point this at the in-cluster address of a silo that mapped MapLatticeScalingSignal(). The path must match LatticeScalingSignalOptions.EndpointPath (default /lattice/scale).
metadata.//unsafeSsl: Set 'true' only when scraping a self-signed HTTPS endpoint in-cluster; prefer plain HTTP on a private network.
metadata.//pollingInterval-note: Polling cadence is configured on the ACA scale rule host (KEDA pollingInterval, default 30s). Keep it at or above the signal's EWMA smoothing window so the autoscaler samples a settled value rather than reacting to per-scrape jitter.
metadata.//stabilizationWindow-note: KEDA/HPA scale-down stabilization (default 300s) holds the replica count at its recent maximum before scaling in. Because scaleValue is already EWMA-smoothed on the producer side, a shorter stabilization window is safe; do not stack an aggressive stabilization window on top of a long EWMA or scale-in will lag twice.
